title: G18: add a one-page build artifact provenance record
public_pr_body:
Adds one short docs/audit template linking exact executed SHA, build run/attempt, immutable artifact ID, SHA-256 of downloaded artifact bytes, separate original-log hash, tester/checker and named approval/signature/date. Actual result stays NOT EXECUTED; all operational fields and approvals stay blank.

Reuses #370's profile/evidence map and #377's log-chain review. Adds the explicit build run/artifact-bytes fields rather than treating a log hash as an artifact hash. Does not claim the existing verifier automatically checks the new field. No build or acceptance executed; source/required-field and whitespace review only.

G18: build template ready; existing profile/verifier work reused; actual build evidence and approval pending. Separate branch from main 68f89ca. Docs only, no production SQL/data, merge, #359/candidate edits, Ready label or message to John.
